'''Revelation Beginning Watto''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 4 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 NMNPND Revelation DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

Help me out.

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

Ten Imp Bars= early protection of Watto. I won?t take one out. Arica+Mara Jade?s Lightsaber+four Snipers= really dead Rebels. Dark Strike, too, but it?s mainly for Sniper. You Are Beaten is too good a card not to play with everything I have. Basically just flip and carry on. This deck is decent in space, as well as ground. Response to PEGD and BH6 (what the heck happened to BH5, anyway?): I totally agree. The problem: I only have two Wattos!
